top_signals.title: Fortescue Mulls Debut Panda Bond Sale Despite China Tensions
top_signals.summary: Australian iron ore miner Fortescue Ltd. is considering raising about 3 billion yuan ($446 million) in its first-ever panda bond offering, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Tanker attack tests Trump’s claim that Hormuz is a 'functioning strait'
top_signals.summary: An oil tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, keeping alive risks deterring vessesl from the vital energy corridor.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Hedge Funds Bet Aussie to Outrun Kiwi on RBA Hike, NZ Vote Risks
top_signals.summary: Hedge funds are boosting bets that the Aussie dollar will outperform the kiwi heading into year-end as prospects for higher Australian interest rates bolster the currency, while New Zealand’s election clouds the nation’s monetary policy outlook.

top_signals.title: Carlos Alcaraz ready to reignite season at U.S. Open after injury layoff
top_signals.summary: Alcaraz has missed most of the clay season, the French Open, Wimbledon and North American hard-court tournaments.
